args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (and v2.2.9) were previously healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. The rollback completed with status `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback.

4. **Verified** — Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is back on v2.3.0, **healthy** in all regions, with error rate down to 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so if it's redeployed later it would require change-manager approval per policy — I did not redeploy it, only rolled back as requested.
